local_gallery.features: Spatial HSV histograms, nearest training crop

teacher_detector_review.scope: Subjective Haiku opinions only, not ground-truth detection metrics. First grader with mismatched coordinates excluded.

limitations: Same-match pilot. Round 2 changed crop selection and reduced the teacher confidence gate from 0.9 to the resolver's 0.8 standard; gains cannot be attributed to crop sharpness alone. Local gallery tests use same-track pseudo-labels, not independent identity ground truth. Two teams remain unresolved; no YOLO weight retraining or broad generalization claim.
